model_numbers: XT2333-1 / XT2333-3 / XT2333-4 / XT2333-5 (BR retail = XT2333 family; MaisCelular lists -1/-3/-4 fichas for Brazil)
notes: Global announce Jan 24, 2023 (Europe first, then select LatAm/Asia markets). Brazil launch Feb 6, 2023 at R$1,599 (4/128, alongside Moto E13); later street promos as low as R$759. NOT officially launched in India — Indian aggregator 'price in India ₹19,999' pages are speculative autogen; no Motorola India listing or reputable IN launch coverage found. Android 14 shipped Jun 2024 (build UHA34.29_060201, ~1.53GB) as the single promised OS update — confirmed final. Discontinued.
caveats: ENCODER RISK (the deciding unknown): Helio G85 does advertise hardware H.265/HEVC encode (MediaTek official spec: H.264 + H.265/HEVC encode, 2K@30 / 1080p60) — unlike the Helio G37 — but budget-MTK rate control ignores frame timestamps (WebRTC forces FRAMERATE_ADJUSTMENT) and CBR compliance is undocumented on this tier; compat-check must verify c2.mtk.hevc.encoder exists AND isBitrateModeSupported(CBR) AND 1920x1080 surface deliverability. UW 118° meets the comfort bar on paper but is a tiny 5 MP f/2.2 unit; third-party CONTROL_ZOOM_RATIO reachability unconfirmed (Motorola budget HALs historically hid aux camera IDs from third-party Camera2 apps) — runtime probe decides. Gyro IS present (verified vs GSMArena — many budget Motos lack one), but the device is NOT on the ARCore certified list, so ≥100 Hz sustained IMU and SENSOR_INFO_TIMESTAMP_SOURCE=REALTIME are both unverified. 25-min thermal unvalidated (1080p30 is a light load and the 12nm G85 is modest, but zero evidence). Brazil-only fleet relevance — not officially sold in India despite aggregator pages claiming ₹19,999.
